front: What is the difference between gender equality and equity?
back: Equality is the same rights and opportunities; equity is fair treatment that may differ to reach equal outcomes.

front: Which sections of the Constitution deal with gender?
back: Section 17 (gender balance), section 56 (equality and non-discrimination), section 80 (rights of women).

front: Name four agents that teach gender roles.
back: Family, religion, school and media (also peers).

front: Why are gender roles said to be learned?
back: They vary between societies and change over time, and children learn them from family, school, religion and media.
